summary: Merged plan for Roundhouse Communities’ first property. The strongest configuration direction is role-based access, property-specific rent-first payment allocation where required, monthly rentable items, affordable workflows, inspection templates, dual-delivery delinquency notices, and resident community features. The latest renewal discussion in c16 advances the earlier undecided position: automatically generated renewal offers with approval are now likely, but still need client confirmation. Most detailed leasing, payment, maintenance, move-out, reporting, and migration choices remain open because the calls were primarily sales and discovery sessions.

settings.meaning: Permissions and training can be assigned consistently by job responsibility instead of configuring every employee independently.
settings.assumption: Exact group names and membership will be finalized during implementation design.
reasoning: Roundhouse wants permissions and training assigned by role, including different training for affordable and conventional teams.
Roundhouse needs a restricted group for an internal or third-party affordable compliance reviewer.
Reusable groups will reduce manual administration as the portfolio grows.

questions.question: How much historical Yardi data should be migrated? Default: detailed general-ledger history needed for trends, opening resident balances for conversion, and retained legacy access for older resident details.
questions.default: Detailed general-ledger history plus opening resident balances
questions.why: Roundhouse needs historical trends, but detailed resident-subledger history can be difficult to reconcile and the final lookback period was not chosen.

turns.text: We're all old. We're all old. Yeah… everybody can see it now. Yes. Yeah. All right. Yay. Okay, great. What are your active risks events? What are your pending decisions? Some high level KPIs across finance, operations and investment. We'll talk a little bit about the flexibility on customization at least in a minute. One of the things that I don't know that I made very clear when we started this is that axp is directly connected to your entrata properties. There's no importing of data. There's no cleaning of data. The property data is synced to your maestro environment and it's either real time or near real time. So as things are happening at the property level, the information and the data is showing up on your maestro environment that connectivity happens for data exchange. But it's also going to happen for communication between the asset management group and the operations team. So we are planning to support communication through email in app, text message. So that any communication that happens between you, it's captured and recorded within the maestro environment… whether it's under an event, if it's related to a loan, if it's related to a capital improvement project, it's all linked together… and stop me at any point. If you have any questions or anything that comes to mind.
Live or near live like immediate or near immediate, like how often is it pulling? Is it just easy? Like what's the worst case scenario? Is it a lag of a half hour? Is it a lag of two minutes? Yeah.

callsUsed.title: Roundhouse Entrata Demo Day 1
callsUsed.brief: Entrata team members, along with Katie and Stacy from Roundhouse Communities, discussed Entrata's comprehensive AP and bank reconciliation workflows, highlighting features like automated approval routing, virtual card payments, and advanced AI-driven agents for task automation. The conversation also delved into Entrata's evolving AI capabilities, including a new chat interface for site teams and the development of a unified data layer to enhance AI functionality and user experience. Key discussions also touched upon the platform's robust month-end closing processes, customizable reporting, and a forward-looking vision for AI integration that aims to streamline operations and improve resident experiences.

callsUsed.title: Roundhouse Entrata Demo
callsUsed.brief: Entrata team members, along with Katie, Stacy and Jodi from Roundhouse Communities, discussed Entrata's comprehensive platform capabilities, focusing on its integrated approach to property operations, resident experience, and financial management, particularly highlighting its strengths in affordable housing compliance and automated workflows. Key discussion points included the platform's AI-driven features like "Eli" for communication and task automation, the "Homebody" app for resident engagement, and robust financial tools for AP, GL, and budgeting, all designed to streamline operations and enhance user experience. The conversation also touched upon the importance of customizable workflows, seamless integrations, and the potential for Entrata to support Roundhouse Communities' growth and scaling objectives.

callsUsed.title: Roundhouse Entrata Demo Day 2
callsUsed.brief: Callin from Entrata, along with Katie from Roundhouse Communities, discussed Entrata's comprehensive utility management platform, highlighting its native integration, automated billing processes, and robust reporting capabilities. The conversation also delved into Entrata's implementation process, emphasizing a phased rollout, dedicated project teams, and extensive training to ensure a smooth transition, with a focus on operationalizing change and providing ongoing support. Key discussion points included the platform's ability to manage complex billing scenarios, streamline maintenance workflows, and offer advanced financial reporting and budgeting tools.

callsUsed.title: Roundhouse - Renewals, Budgeting and BI
callsUsed.brief: Erick from Entrata, along with Morgan from Roundhouse Communities, discussed Entrata's capabilities in renewals, budgeting, and business intelligence. Key highlights included Entrata's automated renewal process, robust budgeting tools that eliminate manual spreadsheet reliance, and a customizable BI platform offering pre-built dashboards and extensive data visualization options. The conversation also touched on the potential for integrating external data and the development of automated variance note generation.

callsUsed.title: Roundhouse - Reporting, BI and Asset Management Discussion
callsUsed.brief: Entrata team members, along with Brittany, Morgan and Katie from Roundhouse Communities, discussed Entrata's reporting, business intelligence, and asset management platforms, highlighting their unified data layer, customization capabilities, and AI-driven insights. Roundhouse expressed a strong need for improved communication, streamlined operations, and efficient reporting, particularly in contrast to their current Yardi system, with a focus on ensuring the new platform supports all business verticals and facilitates data migration. The conversation also touched upon the decision-making process for a potential transition, with operations teams advocating for change and asset management requiring comprehensive details and assurances before approval.
